title: Managed Backup: campaign pricing
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines campaign pricing.

## Tier basis

**Campaign discount fraction.** Discount fraction for a recorded eligible campaign on primary usage; decimal.

**Campaign pricing channels.** Channels eligible for campaign pricing; string list.

| Contract tier | Campaign discount fraction | Campaign pricing channels |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 0.05 | Portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 0.05 | Portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 0.05 | Portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 0.05 | Portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 0.05 | Portal; API |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 0.05 | Portal; API |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, campaign discount fraction is 0.05.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, campaign discount fraction stays the same.
